mechanism.base: Fire sleeps inside wood, the old texts say, and the warmth sits in the grain long before any spark finds it. Dry branches ask to be lit. When the flame takes, the tree gives back in one bright hour what it spent whole seasons building. That is the bargain between them. Growth becomes light and timber becomes warmth, a thing grown quietly in the dark of the trunk and shown to everyone at once.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Fire, the wood piles up unlit, growth stacked with no flame to turn it into light. What you make stays inside the trunk. Show one rough thing before it feels finished.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Fire, the flame draws on green wood, taking sap the tree needs for growing. Everything said costs something unbuilt. Take one quiet evening in for every loud thing out.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire lights it, and what you do can be seen. As a catalyst, the light runs short. Your warmth and wit show in the moment and then fade, and little of it lasts once the evening is over.
function.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Lit by Fire, it runs warm, so nothing you feel waits. As a friction, the gate never shuts, because everything in you wants out at once. You spend yourself on each moment and keep little for the work ahead.
function.definition_balanced: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire lights it, and what you do can be seen. In balance, what you make and what you show keep the same pace. Your warmth and wit reach people at the moment they count.
function.advise_catalyst: Your light runs short, and little of what you make lasts past the moment. Let the rough version out. Play an unfinished song to one friend. Post the drawing with the mistake left in. Bring one thing you made to the next gathering of friends.
function.advise_friction: Seek Water, the Mind energy. Water is rain on the roots, cool and patient, and it turns the flame down low until the wood grows back. Let it feed the wood that Fire burns. You give out faster than you take in. Listen to one album from start to finish. Wait three days before you share your next idea.
function.advise_balanced: Your light reaches people when it counts, and it stays bright while you keep letting work out. Play an unfinished song to one friend. Bring one thing you made to the next gathering of friends.

candidates.cta_verdict: You come alive when something you made gets seen, and most weeks you judge yourself by how much of you got out.

catalyst.clause: The wood piles up unlit, growth stacked with no flame to turn it into light.
catalyst.remedy: Show one rough thing before it feels finished.

friction.clause: The flame draws on green wood, taking sap the tree needs for growing.
friction.remedy: Take one quiet evening in for every loud thing out.

wide.clause: Fire is easy for you to reach, the light every season of growing was for.
wide.remedy: Use it. Say the thing, show the work, let it be seen.

missing.clause: No flame in the wood at all, growth with nowhere to show and no warmth given off.
missing.remedy: Borrow a flame, one listener and one thing shown.

spared.clause: Nothing burns the wood, and a thin trunk keeps all its sap for itself.
spared.remedy: Leave it unlit. Grow first, show later.

thin.clause: A small flame on thin wood, enough to warm the house and too small to eat the tree.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One thing out for every two in.

excess.clause: The fire outgrows the wood that feeds it, and the whole tree burns away as light.
excess.remedy: Stop feeding it. Rest, read, let the wood come back.

friction.clause: The burning outruns the growing: everything lit the moment it grows, no tendril left on the wall.

mechanism_yin.base: Wood is warm by nature, the classics say, and fire sleeps inside it: strip the dry vine, strike the stem, and the hidden flame comes out. Every bundle of cuttings is a lantern waiting for permission. What grew for years in silence burns in an evening, and the light was in the wood all along.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the burning outruns the growing: everything lit the moment it grows, no tendril left on the wall. The flame eats its own hedge. Bank the fire and let some growth stand.

retired_2026-09-21_overlaps.carry.spared.remedy: Keep it green. Show work when it is done.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People gather to your warmth first and your reasons second.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner growth becomes outer light. With Fire running it, expression in you performs: it warms, it dazzles, it spreads by catching. You are at your clearest in front of people, mid-flame, thinking aloud. Feed it seasoned material, work that has dried long enough to burn clean, and your reach turns luminous.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Wood, and Wood feeds Fire: dry branches make the flame. Whatever your growth pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where what you have grown turns to light and heat for others. Every talk given, every gathering warmed, every idea that catches is your years of quiet branching, finally burning visible.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: You discover what you think by saying it while it burns.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Fire is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is where what you have built becomes visible: presenting, hosting, putting your name on the work. Visibility feeds you more than you expect.

Warm in front of people, warmer after. The demo day, the dinner table, the post that finally goes up: each one returns more energy than it cost, and the weeks you hid your work were the weeks it got heavy.

Light is part of how work finishes. Show one finished thing a week, publicly and on purpose. Say yes to the toast, the talk, the intro. When something stalls, share it half-done and let being seen restart it.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Fire is your Expression, and as a friction, it is visibility outrunning capacity: announcing early, performing energy you do not have, saying yes on stage and paying for it offstage.

Charismatic, obliging, quietly overdrawn. The launch is announced before the build, the calendar fills with appearances, and the gap between the public energy and the private reserve gets covered with performance nobody can bill.

An audience is a loan against tomorrow. Borrow less: pull the launch dates back by half, decline one appearance a month, and let the next thing be seen only when it is done. Practice being unimpressive in safe company.
